The paper proposes a method for simultaneous feature selection and classification in longitudinal functional data with categorical outcomes by formulating a logistic-loss optimization on functional predictors. It leverages functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm that exploits sparsity for dimensionality reduction, enabling high-dimensional scalability and demonstrating strong performance in simulations and a real study on chronic diseases and socio-demographic factors.
